dct_description_sm: This layer captures the driven portions of private and public driveways. The data includes attributes indicating the status of each driveway (such as active or proposed) and the material composition (e.g., brick, concrete, gravel, pavement). The information is maintained using the latest aerial imagery updates and serves purposes related to general presentation and analysis of transportation infrastructure.
